name: Statistics Canada data collection clerk (survey interviewer)
summary: Statistics Canada hires data collection clerks as needed, for up to 35 hours a week, to run survey interviews, mostly by phone, from home or on-site.
whatYouDo: You contact selected households or businesses, mostly by telephone and sometimes in person, explain the survey, ask the questions and enter answers into a computer-assisted system. Some roles involve visiting respondents' homes in your region.
appeal: Can be done from home or on-site depending on operational needs
Federal employer; clerks may be eligible for Public Service group insurance benefit plans
Occupation typically needs high school plus on-the-job training
Ontario median wage for survey interviewers and statistical clerks is about $24.18/hr (Job Bank, all employers)
watchOuts: Hiring is 'as needed'; no current Ontario posting was confirmed
Phone-heavy: lots of calls to strangers, some of whom assume it is a scam (worker reviews)
Hours up to 35/week; reviewers say many roles are part-time
2026 Census field jobs (reported $25.87/hr enumerators, May-July 2026) are over
A reported posting required reliable home phone service and willingness to travel

training.notes: On-the-job training usually provided for this occupation (NOC description).

compensation.notes: StatCan page lists no salary. Job Bank Ontario median for the occupation is $24.18/hr (range $17.60-$59.13, all employers). A secondary listing reported $25.87/hr for 2026 Census enumerators.

reliability.notes: Hired as needed for up to 35 hrs/week; reviews mention mostly part-time positions.

applicationSteps: Check Statistics Canada's 'Jobs in data collection' page for current openings in your region
Follow the application instructions in the posting
Make sure you have a quiet space and reliable phone service if working from home
fitsIf: You are comfortable making many phone calls to strangers and want a government job that may be done from home.
notFitIf: You dislike phone work or rejection, or you need guaranteed full-time hours.
